headline: No budget changes this week: the LinkedIn pause and Meta cut are holding, and the direct surge still tracks AI-assistant answers, not paid spend.

tests.hypothesis: Google Search's incremental CPA is well above the $19.64 last-click CPA, because last-touch gives it 68% of credit versus 39% first-touch, and 47-50% of buyers say 'Google' while many may have been persuaded by AI assistants or Meta first.
tests.design: Geo holdout: pause Google Search in about 15% of matched regions for 3 to 4 weeks, with brand and non-brand campaigns tagged separately and the budget kept at $600/day elsewhere. Measure total conversions (tracked plus direct) per region, plus the self-reported 'Google' share. Compare the drop against the roughly 219 conversions per week Google reports. Don't cut Google until it reads out, since it's about 58% of spend.

flag_verdicts.reason: Meta CPA is $89 this week vs $98-105 before the cut, and ROAS is 1.97 vs 1.95. Spend fell 22% and conversions fell only 31 vs 35.75. The cut did no visible harm. The models disagree on Meta (CPA $45-$70), so hold at $400 until the geo holdout reads out.
Already acted on. LinkedIn is paused at $0 and there were 0 conversions on $5,328 in the 14 days before the pause. Self-reported LinkedIn share is 0% for 3 weeks. Keep it paused.
The Sep 12-18 Google spend spike ran at 1.72x median spend with CPA at $20.56 vs $18.33. Efficiency barely moved, and current CPA is $19.64 with ROAS 9.86. No action.

Direct is 63 conversions/week vs a 56 prior average, and up from about 10/week in early Oct by the flag's measure. Paid spend ratio is 0.95. Self-reported 'Asked ChatGPT' is 24% in the latest week, up from 2-6% in Aug. Treat it as an untracked AI-assistant effect and don't credit any paid channel. No budget move, since there is no AI lever to buy.

flags.message: meta CPA rose 1.6x, from $60 to $98, starting 2026-10-02.
linkedin CPA rose 19.1x, from $148 to $2825, starting 2026-10-17.
google_search spend jumped for 7 days (2026-09-12 to 2026-09-18); CPA held at $21 vs $18. Likely fine, confirm before acting.
Direct conversions grew 5.9x (1.5 to 8.9/day) while paid spend moved 0.95x. Self-reported AI answers went from 6% to 25%. Something untracked is driving buyers.
